title: The Big Crunch & the Big Bounce
description: Enough matter, or dark energy that decays, and the expansion stops and reverses: everything falls back into a crunch. Quantum geometry may refuse the singularity, at the Planck density gravity repels, and the crunch bounces into a new expansion. Unlocks the Bounce Core.

puzzle.goal: Quantum geometry modifies the expansion of the universe near the Planck scale: the square of the Hubble rate is the classical 8πGρ/3 multiplied by a factor that vanishes when the density ρ reaches a critical density, and the curvature k of a closed universe adds its usual term. Write the corrected expansion rate.
puzzle.name: Effective Friedmann equation of loop quantum cosmology (the Big Bounce)
puzzle.ask: At ρ = ρ_c the expansion stops and the collapse bounces. For k = 0 the expansion is fastest at ρ = ρ_c/2, where H² = 2πGρ_c/3. With G = 1 and ρ_c = ρ (Planck units), find the largest Hubble rate.
puzzle.method: The correction is quadratic in ρ: put x = ρ/ρ_c and find where x(1 − x) is largest.
